insights.claim_template: The net trade float is {money:float}: {money:trade_receivables} owed by customers against {money:trade_payables} owed to suppliers — {measure:dso} of sales outstanding against {measure:dpo} of payables ({money:dpo_payables} of balance-sheet payables over {money:total_operating_expense} of total operating expense, on {measure:period_days}), a gap of {measure:float_days}.
insights.formula: DSO = trade receivables net ÷ revenue × the period's days; DPO = balance-sheet payables ÷ total operating expense × the period's days (the ratio table's one DPO, engine.ratios.table.dpo_days); float = trade receivables net − trade payables

narrative.explanation: The net trade float is RON -2,633,068.76: RON 27,193.95 owed by customers against RON 2,660,262.71 owed to suppliers — 61 days of sales outstanding against 33 days of payables (RON 2,660,262.76 of balance-sheet payables over RON 29,280,043.30 of total operating expense, on 365 days), a gap of 28 days. Graded critical: the amount at stake is 1,621.7% of revenue, against the ladder printed beside this finding. Trade float is a claim on a year of trading, so it is graded as a share of that year's revenue — the same base both day counts already annualise against.
